blocks.text: Get ready for the experience of a lifetime
Join us on an amazing journey of discovery at the heart of the Red Sea coral reef, a place full of spectacular fish, coral and marine creatures.
blocks.html: Join us on an amazing journey of discovery at the heart of the Red Sea coral reef, a place full of spectacular fish, coral and marine creatures.

blocks.text: The Underwater Observatory, is without a doubt, one of the world's most fascinating sites, where you can have the deepest available experience of the Red Sea.
blocks.html: The Underwater Observatory, is without a doubt, one of the world's most fascinating sites, where you can have the deepest available experience of the Red Sea.

blocks.text: The Park offers many chances to watch feeding of sea creatures, enjoy rich tutorials and experience the breathtaking underwater world. We are proud to have the famous Observatory Tower, the only one of its kind in the world, which allows you to observe marine life in its natural habitat, without getting wet.

items: Jewelry and Souvenir ShopsGifts to treasure!Our souvenir shop offers a variety of sea and holiday inspired gifts and souvenirs, book, games and a selection of exclusive items.The Park has two jewelry shops with a spectacular selection of original and unique jewelry, created by leading Israeli and international artisans.Purchase tickets and activities for over 800 shekels and get free one year entrance pass.To schedule a visit to the Park's jewelry shops only, please call 08-6364225.

Park RestaurantsDelicious!The Park's restaurant offers a fantastic selection of vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals for children and adults, a range of fresh sandwiches, pizza, ice cream, desserts and refreshing drinks.Then there is also the Park's cafeteria and coffee bar, located on the entrance floor of the Observatory Tower and near the Aqua Dome. Here you can enjoy a variety of light meals, snacks and drinks.Bon Appetite!

Educational CenterThe David Friedman Educational CenterAt the Underwater Observatory we hope for a future where people protect and advocate for the health of the Red Sea. With this in mind, we created the David Friedman Educational Center.The classroom, established 17 years ago by David Friedman, the park's first scientific director is an interactive and engaging environment for students to learn about the marine life of the Red Sea and how to conserve it.These classes are given for various schools in the city of Eilat and expose the students to the wonders of the Red Sea, while taking part in the restoration of the reef and its surroundings.We believe that our role is to teach our children to respect, understand and love the Red Sea and in these classes children are given the chance to understand conservation projects that takes place in the Underwater Observatory such as: reproduction and rehabilitation project of sea turtles, seahorses and more

items: 1 XThe Welcome AquariumA great way to start !See a characteristic Red Sea coral reef, from all angles,from the minute you enter the park.

2 XRed Sea Coral Reef Aquarium.Description: This is a huge circular aquarium showing a replica of the magnificent coral reef of Eilat.It is one of the largest replica reefs in the world and boasts a number of real corals.Watch the Red sea in action here!

3 XThe Sting-ray caveDescription: In the Sting-ray cave resides giant sting rays measuring 2 meters and more. Take this photo opportunity and wave to your family from inside the aquarium, just like a professional diver.More Information:Advanced booking is required, only availablefrom age 8 upward.Diving is from age 8.

4 XThe Turtle PoolDescription: The turtle pool is a beautiful habitat for two types of Turtle species.In a comfortable and warm recreation of their natural living conditions, our turtle pool is a great place for you to peek in on the everyday habits of these intriguing animals.Take a look!
5 XSnorkelling poolIn the Snorkeling pool, there is, you guessed it, an opportunity to snorkel.This is also the only place you can view coral in the Underwater Observatory from an aerial view.

6 XPetting and Feeding PoolDescription: Get an interactive taste of marine life and join in by feeding and petting our Coyfish.Keep your children engaged and entertained!Details may be subject to change.

7 XShark WorldDescription: Featuring a huge shark pool, an interactive activity center and a transparent tunnel.Come face-to-fin with the predators of the Red Sea, including sharks, sting rays, manta rays, schools of fish and vibrant colonies of coral.Start a shark adventure!

8 XAquadomeDescription: Join us in the Aquadome for an intense 360 ° visual experience of whales. Uncover the many secrets from their fascinating lives and immerse yourself into a sensory experience. Dive in today!
9 XExplanation PoolsDescription: At this spot, our instructors provide in-depth information about our aquatic residents.Details may be subject to change

10 XUnderwater Observatory TowerDescription: The Observatory sits on the coral reef reserve. You can enter the Observatory and view the reef from the inside by walking down the stairs, to 6 meters below sea level.Here you can watch hundreds of species of fish, coral and invertebrates living in the magnificent Red Sea.This is a totally unique experience!
11 XPeace TerraceLook out over 4 different countries from our Peace Terrace, located at the Underwater Observatory Tower.See Israel, Jordan, Egypt and Saudi Arabia!

12 XCreatures of the DeepDescription: With several video panels screens, the Creatures of the Deep exhibition boasts intriguing and rare coverage of animals that live more than 1000 meters below the surface.This is a dark and challenging place with unique lifeforms, unreachable for the majority of people, including experienced divers.

13 XPearl Secrets.Description: Watch pearls being removed from their shells in this timeless and magical activity. Then if you so wish, pop into our Jewelry store and purchase something beautiful, rare and unique.

14 XRare Fish AquariumDescription: The Rare Fish Aquarium has 35 aquariums and over 800 species of rare and beautiful fish, coral and spectacular marine creatures.Discover the colorful and unusual predators, invertebrates, corals and fish – only found in the Gulf of Eilat!

15 XEducation CenterIn the Education center, we hold many lectures and in-depth learning sessions. You can view our conservation projects, including the rehabilitation of coral, one of our cornerstone sustainability projects

16 XCoral 2000Description: Coral 2000 is a submersible boat with 48 incredible underwater windows. Rather than looking down, the Coral 2000 gives you a panoramic view of the reef.Take this chance to meet rare fish, coral colonies and amazing sea creatures in their natural habitat. More information: * Advanced booking is required The boat departs from the Coral Pier located on the bridge leading to the Observation Tower

items: 01How much does it cost to go to the Underwater Observatory? All the Underwater Observatory's ticket prices, special offers and packages are found here.

02What is the best time to visit the Underwater Observatory? The Underwater Observatory is open daily from 9:00am to 16:00pm. Our marine park is spacious and offers a variety of activities, so whatever time you choose to come, you'll have plenty to do! To maximize your visit we recommend that you plan for both tours led by our guides and to be watch the animals at feeding times (posted here on the website).
03What time do they feed the fish and marine creatures? Feeding times and guided tour schedules can be viewed here.

04How long is a visit to the Underwater Observatory? The Underwater Observatory has lots to see and explore and we recommend that you plan a 3 - 4 hour visit, including a stop at one of our top quality on-site restaurants.
05Can I get to the Underwater Observatory by public transport? Egged, the Israeli intercity bus service stop sat the entrance of the Underwater Observatory - the bus line number is 15.

06Is there parking available? The Underwater Observatory has large on-site parking facilities. Please take into account that on busy days and in peak season the car park is full. That's why we recommend taking public transport - Egged's bus line 15, which stops at the entrance to the Underwater Observatory.

07Do I need to print my tickets before I get to the Underwater Observatory, if I book online? There is no need to print your tickets before you arrive, you can collect them at the kiosk next to the Ticket Office.
08What credit cards do you take? The Underwater Observatory accepts all types of credit cards.

items: 09Does the Underwater Observatory take Loyalty Clubs? The Underwater Observatory collaborates with a host of Loyalty Clubs. If you are a member of a Loyalty Club, please check with the club directly to find out if they collaborate with us.
10From what age do I have to pay for children? Children under the age of 3 enjoy free entrance to the Underwater Observatory.

11Does the Underwater Observatory have a place to store personal items? Of course! For you to comfortably explore the Underwater Observatory you can rent a locker for your bags and belongings for just 5 NIS. The size of the locker is approximately the size of a small suitcase.

12Am I allowed to photograph the displays and exhibitions? Yes! For the wellbeing of our marine creatures, please ensure to take photos without using a flash! Feel free to upload photos of your visit on the various social networks - don't forget to tag us!

13Can I use my ticket more than once? Yes! The ticket you purchase is valid for 3 consecutive days from the date of your first entry. Please note :To extend your ticket for an additional two days, contact the photo booth located opposite the Underwater Observatory's entrance, get your photo taken and bring the photo with you when you want to return.

14Are wheelchairs available? Definitely! Please contact the security guard at the Underwater Observatory entrance and he will provide you with a wheelchair. For your convenience, we recommend contacting us in advance at 08-6364209 to reserve a wheelchair during your visit.

15Does the Underwater Observatory have an area I can nurse my baby? Of course! The Underwater Observatory accomodates for nursing mothers and provides a particularly intimate and comfortable nursing area in the souvenir shop.

16Is the Underwater Observatory equipped with First Aid equipment and medical staff? First aid equipment is available at the Underwater Observatory's main office. Medics are always on-site and will assist if necessary.

blocks.text: From what age do I have to pay for children?
Children under the age of 3 enjoy free entrance to the Underwater Observatory.
blocks.html: Children under the age of 3 enjoy free entrance to the Underwater Observatory.

blocks.text: Does the Underwater Observatory have a place to store personal items?
Of course!
blocks.html: Of course!

blocks.text: For you to comfortably explore the Underwater Observatory you can rent a locker for your bags and belongings for just 5 NIS.
blocks.html: For you to comfortably explore the Underwater Observatory you can rent a locker for your bags and belongings for just 5 NIS.

blocks.text: The size of the locker is approximately the size of a small suitcase.
blocks.html: The size of the locker is approximately the size of a small suitcase.

blocks.text: Am I allowed to photograph the displays and exhibitions?
Yes! For the wellbeing of our marine creatures, please ensure to take photos without using a flash!
blocks.html: Yes! For the wellbeing of our marine creatures, please ensure to take photos without using a flash!

blocks.text: Feel free to upload photos of your visit on the various social networks - don't forget to tag us!
blocks.html: Feel free to upload photos of your visit on the various social networks - don't forget to tag us!

blocks.text: Can I use my ticket more than once?
Yes! The ticket you purchase is valid for 3 consecutive days from the date of your first entry.
blocks.html: Yes! The ticket you purchase is valid for 3 consecutive days from the date of your first entry.

blocks.text: Please note :
blocks.html: Please note :

blocks.text: To extend your ticket for an additional two days, contact the photo booth located opposite the Underwater Observatory's entrance, get your photo taken and bring the photo with you when you want to return.
blocks.html: To extend your ticket for an additional two days, contact the photo booth located opposite the Underwater Observatory's entrance, get your photo taken and bring the photo with you when you want to return.

blocks.text: Are wheelchairs available?
Definitely!
blocks.html: Definitely!

blocks.text: Please contact the security guard at the Underwater Observatory entrance and he will provide you with a wheelchair.
blocks.html: Please contact the security guard at the Underwater Observatory entrance and he will provide you with a wheelchair.

blocks.text: For your convenience, we recommend contacting us in advance at 08-6364209 to reserve a wheelchair during your visit.
blocks.html: For your convenience, we recommend contacting us in advance at 08-6364209 to reserve a wheelchair during your visit.

blocks.text: Does the Underwater Observatory have an area I can nurse my baby?
Of course!
blocks.html: Of course!

blocks.text: The Underwater Observatory accomodates for nursing mothers and provides a particularly intimate and comfortable nursing area in the souvenir shop.
blocks.html: The Underwater Observatory accomodates for nursing mothers and provides a particularly intimate and comfortable nursing area in the souvenir shop.

blocks.text: Is the Underwater Observatory equipped with First Aid equipment and medical staff?
First aid equipment is available at the Underwater Observatory's main office.
blocks.html: First aid equipment is available at the Underwater Observatory's main office.

blocks.text: Medics are always on-site and will assist if necessary.
blocks.html: Medics are always on-site and will assist if necessary.
